description: Adversarial external attestations. plugin_cases run external_attestation at verifier_version against context; resolution_cases apply expiry and revocation, where an attestation's signer is its verifier_id and its digest is the digest of its payload. witness_cases run witness_quorum@1.0.0 over all the attestations, with verified_domains as the service's domain records. conflict_cases list the conflicts among attestations in effect at `at`, each claim's subject being obligation_id/deliverable_id/check_id. declared_executions are the run descriptors the counterparty declared; each one's binding is executionBinding(descriptor).

plugin_cases.name: valid
plugin_cases.description: Control: bound to a declared run of the agreed skill, citing evidence on the obligation.

plugin_cases.name: execution_not_declared
plugin_cases.description: Cites a run no obligation.started event declared.

plugin_cases.name: execution_digest_altered
plugin_cases.description: Cites a declared execution_id with the digest of a different descriptor.

plugin_cases.name: skill_mismatch
plugin_cases.description: Cites a declared run that performed a different skill from terms.skill.

plugin_cases.name: execution_required
plugin_cases.description: The terms name a skill, but the attestation cites no run.

plugin_cases.name: expired
plugin_cases.description: Expired before the evaluation time, so it does not count.

plugin_cases.name: not_yet_valid
plugin_cases.description: issued_at is more than 5 minutes after the evaluation time.

plugin_cases.name: within_clock_skew
plugin_cases.description: issued_at is 4 minutes after the evaluation time, inside the allowed skew.

plugin_cases.name: subject_mismatch
plugin_cases.description: An attestation for obligation A submitted on obligation B.

plugin_cases.name: key_revoked
plugin_cases.description: Signed with a key revoked before the attestation's issued_at.

plugin_cases.name: evidence_not_on_obligation
plugin_cases.description: Cites an evidence digest never submitted on the obligation.

plugin_cases.name: legacy_payload_1_1
plugin_cases.description: A 1.0-shaped attestation, terms without a skill: still passes under 1.1.0.

plugin_cases.name: legacy_payload_1_0
plugin_cases.description: The same attestation under the unchanged 1.0.0 plugin.

resolution_cases.name: revoked_by_own_signer
resolution_cases.description: The reviewer revokes its own attestation: it stays visible, marked revoked, and does not count.

resolution_cases.name: revoked_by_other_signer
resolution_cases.description: The auditor tries to revoke the reviewer's attestation: refused, and the original still counts.

resolution_cases.name: unknown_reference
resolution_cases.description: A ref names an attestation that is not in the set: reported, and nothing else changes.

witness_cases.name: independent_witness
witness_cases.description: Control: one witness on its own verified domain, quorum 1.

payload.summary: Observed the run produce the patch

witness_cases.name: witness_on_counterparty_domain
witness_cases.description: The only witness shares the counterparty's verified domain, so it is not independent.

payload.summary: Observed the run produce the patch

witness_cases.name: two_witnesses_one_domain
witness_cases.description: Two witnesses under one registrable domain count once; the quorum of 2 is not met.

payload.summary: Observed the run produce the patch
Observed the run produce the patch

witness_cases.name: two_independent_witnesses
witness_cases.description: Control: two witnesses on different domains meet a quorum of 2.

payload.summary: Observed the run produce the patch
Observed the run produce the patch

witness_cases.name: witness_not_agreed
witness_cases.description: The witness is not in witness_agent_ids, so it does not count.

payload.summary: Observed the run produce the patch

witness_cases.name: independence_unverifiable
witness_cases.description: The counterparty has no verified domain, so overlap cannot be checked.

payload.summary: Observed the run produce the patch

conflict_cases.name: execution_mismatch
conflict_cases.description: Two runs were declared (agent 1.0.0 and 1.1.0); two verifiers judged the same check on different runs.

conflict_cases.name: disputed_by_other_verifier
conflict_cases.description: The auditor disputes the reviewer's pass with its own fail: both are kept, as a disagreement and a dispute.

conflict_cases.name: equivocation
conflict_cases.description: The reviewer signs both pass and fail for the same check without revoking either.

conflict_cases.name: revoked_then_replaced
conflict_cases.description: Control: the reviewer revokes its pass and signs a fail; a revoked attestation no longer conflicts.
